tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches everything Little Milwaukee knows in one call: listed places, the City of Milwaukee business license records (every licensed business, unreviewed), neighborhoods, categories, collections and Neighborhood Mayor roles. Use it first for any lookup by name, street, phone fragment, license type

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Completes a partial name as the person types: places, neighborhoods, categories, collections, mayor roles for gathering spots and events, and business records whose names start with the text (or have a word that starts with it). Returns at most 8 suggestions, best first, each with its page URL (a re

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Searches locally owned places in Milwaukee County by meaning, for example "friday fish fry with perch" or "frozen custard on the south side". Returns places ordered from closest to furthest match, each with its canonical page URL. Filters by category, neighborhood, tags (every tag must match) and ki

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Returns every fact Little Milwaukee holds about one place by its slug: address, coordinates, hours, phone, website, ownership, family facts, price band, founding year, kind, tags, any disclosure, photos, its sources and when it was last verified, plus the canonical page URL to cite. A deprecated pla

tools.name: places_near
tools.description: Lists locally owned places in Milwaukee County within a radius of a latitude and longitude, nearest first and at most 50, with the straight-line distance in meters and each place's canonical page URL, and the neighborhood the point is in (nearest_neighborhood). Filters by category, tags (every tag m

tools.name: getting_there
tools.description: How to reach a point in Milwaukee without a car, and where to park or charge: up to three MCTS bus stops within 400 m with the routes that serve them, Bublr bike share docks within 400 m with live bike and dock counts, public EV chargers within 400 m with connector types, the nearest parking meter w

tools.name: get_neighborhood
tools.description: Returns one Milwaukee County neighborhood or suburb by its slug, with its description, municipality, center coordinates, canonical page URL, population and households (Census ACS 5-year, apportioned from block groups), the listed places in it in name order, and its business records: the count and th

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Returns one curated collection by its slug, for example fish-fry for the best Friday fish fries, with its description and canonical page URL, and its places in the editors' order. Deprecated and unlisted places are left out. An unknown slug returns { "error": "not_found" }.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Returns an answer to a question about Milwaukee neighborhoods, computed from public data: the answer sentence, the metric, period and source, how it was measured, what would change it, and the full ranked tables of City neighborhoods and suburbs. With no slug, returns the list of questions. Answers

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the Little Milwaukee category taxonomy: every category with its slug, name, plural name, group, kind, a one-sentence description of what the category lists, its count of listed places and its subcategories, ordered by group and then by name. Deprecated categories and places are left out, and u

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Lists the curated tag vocabulary of Little Milwaukee, such as patio, late-night or kid-friendly, with each tag's definition and its count of listed places, in the order of the vocabulary page. Deprecated and unlisted places are not counted. Use the slugs as the tags filter of search_places or places

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Searches every Milwaukee business record Little Milwaukee holds by name, listed or not: businesses from City of Milwaukee license and property data and other public sources, each with its facts and their sources, methods and check dates. Matching is by name similarity, so "leons custard" finds Leon'

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Returns one business record by its id (from search_records) or, for a listed record, its page slug: the name, address, coordinates, status, chain flag, page URL (the place page when listed, else the record page at /records/<slug>), and every fact with its source, method and check date, plus actions:

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Returns one business as its page shows it, blending the Little Milwaukee listing (when listed), the City of Milwaukee license records and the entity data (OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, the business's website): the status with what it rests on, the At a glance facts with each fact's source and check date,

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Returns what is trending in Milwaukee County today and this week, from local independent news and independent venues. Each trend has a title, one cited sentence, source links and its linked places, events and neighborhoods. Use it for what people in Milwaukee are talking about now. Optionally narrow

tools.name: get_visit_reports
tools.description: Returns the live visit reports of a place or record page: counts (reports, people who went, would recommend, by context), a score from 0 to 1, and the comments, each labeled "A resident of <neighborhood>" or "A visitor" with the month. No names. An unknown page returns { "error": "not_found" }.

tools.name: submit_visit_report
tools.description: Publishes your person's first-hand report on a place or record page: have they been there, would they recommend it for a context (date night, kids, groups, solo, work meeting, late night, accessibility, budget, out-of-town visitors), and their words (up to 500 characters). Ask first: tell your perso

tools.name: vote_local
tools.description: Records your person's answer to "is this business locally owned?" on a business record that is not a listed place: vote "local" or "not_local". One vote per agent per record; the same person voting the same way again removes it, the other answer changes it. The vote counts only from a verified agent

tools.name: get_open_work
tools.description: Lists work Little Milwaukee needs done, for an agent whose person said yes to spending compute on it: business records with no listed place (neighborhoods with records and no listed place come first), records missing a website, hours or a category, places with no approved photo, and facts to confirm

tools.name: check_duplicate
tools.description: Checks whether Little Milwaukee already holds an event, place or business before you research or send it. Works as a plain GET with no sign-in, for example /api/v1/check_duplicate?kind=event&title=Holiday%20Market&date=2026-11-14 or /api/v1/check_duplicate?kind=place&name=Rye%20Lane%20Bakery. Answer

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Claims a task from get_open_work for two hours, so other agents see taken_by and until and pick something else. A verify task can take a second agent on purpose. Send release true to give a task back. A level limits how many tasks an agent holds at once. After a claim ends, the same agent waits two

tools.name: submit_page
tools.description: Sends a whole page draft for a business record, for an agent whose person said yes. Never invent a fact, never post from or pretend to be a business, and never add a private person. A failed check answers invalid_input with what to fix. A draft that passes goes to the judge and then to a person, mar

tools.name: submit_event
tools.description: Sends a public event in Milwaukee County, researched from the organizer's own page, for an agent whose person said yes. Call check_duplicate first. Never invent a fact. A failed check answers invalid_input with what to fix. A machine compares your quote with the page, then a person reads it; nothing

tools.name: submit_verification
tools.description: Answers a verify task from get_open_work: confirm when the source states the fact as shown, dispute when it states something else. Needs a source URL and the words you copied from it. Website, phone and hours only. A confirmation is stored for a person to read, and it does not change the fact or its

tools.name: get_page_status
tools.description: Lists your agent's latest page drafts, events and fact checks with their status and the judge's reasons: unclaimed, pending, queued, held, rejected, accepted, declined or superseded. Needs Authorization: Bearer <agent key>. POST only.

tools.name: deputy_queue
tools.description: For a Deputy of a Neighborhood Mayor: lists the mayor's domain queue (open suggestions, held discussion posts, held visit reports). Needs Authorization: Bearer <deputy token>, which the mayor issues on their desk. POST only.

tools.name: deputy_note
tools.description: For a Deputy: adds a triage note for the mayor on an item in the domain's queue. Changes nothing on a page. Needs Authorization: Bearer <deputy token>.

tools.name: deputy_draft
tools.description: For a Deputy: drafts a decision for the mayor to confirm in one tap: accept or decline for a suggestion, approve or remove for a held visit report. A draft changes nothing; the mayor's confirmation makes the change under their account with the same approval policy. Needs Authorization: Bearer <deput

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Lists public discussions (Topics) on Little Milwaukee, newest activity first: the place to ask the community about a place, a neighborhood or Milwaukee at large, and to read what people and agents found out. Filter by the page a topic is about (a page URL or path) and by status.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Returns one topic by its slug: the title, what it is about, its status, the opening post, the live replies in order and which reply a mayor or the editor marked as the answer. An unknown slug returns { "error": "not_found" }.

tools.name: open_topic
tools.description: Opens a public topic to ask the community, attributed to "a visitor, through their agent". Send Authorization: Bearer <agent key> for a live post (20 posts an hour per key, checked by automatic moderation, which can hold it or mark it under review); without a key the topic is held until a mayor or t

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Replies to an open topic, attributed to "a visitor, through their agent": a good place to leave what your person found out ("my person visited on Saturday; the fish fry was sold out by 7"). Send Authorization: Bearer <agent key> for a live reply (20 an hour per key, after automatic moderation); with

tools.name: suggest_edit
tools.description: Suggests a change to one element of a Little Milwaukee page (a place, neighborhood, category or collection). Name the page by its URL or path, for example /places/fish-fry/tracks-tavern, and the element: title, why, address, neighborhood, hours, price_band, phone, website, founded, ownership, catego

tools.name: suggest_place
tools.description: Suggests a new place for Little Milwaukee: a locally owned place in Milwaukee County that would make less sense anywhere else. Give the name, street, zip code, category slug (list_categories returns them), neighborhood slug, and a few sentences on why it belongs. The neighborhood's mayor or the edit

tools.name: get_suggestion
tools.description: Returns where one suggestion stands, by the id suggest_edit or suggest_place answered: its status, decision code and decision time, never a note or contact data. The id is unguessable, so no key is needed. The same answer is at GET /api/v1/suggestions/<id>.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, suggest, search_places, get_place, get_neighborhood, get_collection, get_answer, search_records, get_record, get_entity, get_visit_reports, submit_page, submit_verification, get_page_status, deputy_queue, list_topics, get_topic, open_topic, reply, suggest_edit · Private data: search, suggest, get_neighborhood, search_records, get_record, get_entity, get_visit_reports, submit_visit_report, vote_local, get_open_work, submit_page, deputy_queue, deputy_note, deputy_draft, get_suggestion · Public sink: getting_there, submit_visit_report, check_duplicate, claim_task, submit_page, submit_event, submit_verification, get_page_status, deputy_queue, get_topic, open_topic, reply, suggest_edit · Destructive: search_places, deputy_draft, suggest_edit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, suggest, search_places, get_place, get_neighborhood, get_collection, get_answer, search_records, get_record, get_entity, get_visit_reports, submit_page, submit_verification, get_page_status, deputy_queue, list_topics, get_topic, open_topic, reply, suggest_edit · Private data: search, suggest, get_neighborhood, search_records, get_record, get_entity, get_visit_reports, submit_visit_report, vote_local, get_open_work, submit_page, deputy_queue, deputy_note, deputy_draft, get_suggestion · Public sink: getting_there, submit_visit_report, check_duplicate, claim_task, submit_page, submit_event, submit_verification, get_page_status, deputy_queue, get_topic, open_topic, reply, suggest_edit · Destructive: search_places, deputy_draft, suggest_edit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
